integrity: The universal claim is supported by a self-contained proof using filter differences, an explicit Dilworth blow-up, and exact equality analysis. Exact integer finite checks are reproducible with verify.py. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty posets and strictly positive diagonal Euclidean coordinate scales; no arbitrary oblique affine maps. Earlier equivalent historical work remains possible. Finite experiments support, rather than establish, the general theorem.
title: Weighted longest chains determine all minimum-width directions of order polytopes
